label: H.R. 7294
title: AI for Secure Networks Act

items.snippet: This bill requires the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) to study and report to Congress on the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) technology on the security of telecommunications networks.

M001226.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
M001226.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
